name: How long does it take to build a new room addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a new room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a new room addition varies significantly based on its size, complexity, design choices, and the permitting process. Simple additions might take 3-6 months from design to completion, while more complex projects can extend to 8-12 months or longer. Factors like material availability and the speed of permit approvals from local authorities in the East Bay can also influence the schedule. We prioritize efficient project management to minimize disruptions while maintaining quality.
acceptedAnswer.description: New room additions typically take 3-12 months, depending on size, complexity, and permitting, which varies by location.
